items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: he'd take us and get out on them good timers and go around them houses and take the band and go around.

ctx.x: Did you ever play in any of the houses with your guitar too?

We used to go around with different bands sometimes, you know, like this fella, what you call it, Chester Moshe? No, I don't know about that. He was a young fella, you know, his daddy with a hat on, that big clothing store there, a dolphin. Well, he used to have plenty of money and he'd like good time. I was de Moshe. Yeah, he'd take us and get out on them good timers and go around them houses and take the band and go around.
What, is it just a small string group or bigger? Yeah, small.
